method_note: ADD candidates derived from the live superset (PrimaryRoleId RO197 + RO57 + RO107 for trusts, RO261 name-filtered to "INTEGRATED CARE BOARD" for ICBs; RO57 returned an empty set this run) minus DB membership, then filtered by Date[Legal].End. REMOVE candidates come from a FULL Legal-End sweep of all 243 DB members, not just the /sync change feed: the feed only surfaces orgs whose ODS record changed since last_ods_sync_date, so an org that died months ago and has not been touched since is invisible to it (RNK, legal end 2026-03-31, is the standing example). The plain set-difference misses them too because a merged org keeps Status "Active".
